description: Potsdam Integrated Assessment Modeling Framework (PIAM) is a framework listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Frameworks", published or maintained by Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK). An energy-system framework registered on the Open Energy Platform. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Software: R, GAMS. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
